decisions: OptionBackfillPlan selects active T024 contracts with the existing T052 OptionChainSelector for each completed XNYS session, replaces the deterministic daily front-set key, and emits one OSI symbol-day queue item per selected contract.

The option coverage catalog is the resume checkpoint: complete and terminal-empty trade/quote rows are skipped, while missing, partial, and error rows remain actionable. Planning and queue payloads contain no provider or Azure behavior.

OptionIngestTransaction uses the T053 option client, T022 PartitionWriter factory, and T034 AtomicIngestCommitter boundary. It stages trade and quote objects privately, validates OSI metadata and session bounds, and replaces deterministic option paths and coverage keys.

Closed zero-row trade or quote responses publish valid empty Parquet objects and CoverageStatus.EMPTY, preserving illiquid sessions as terminal catalog state. Provider or normalization failures publish error coverage without objects.

OptionQueueHandler is supplied to the existing T035 QueueWorker, so lease renewal, retry, dead-letter, and delete-after-success semantics are not duplicated. Worker clock, option client, writer, committer, and queue sender boundaries are injectable in tests.
limitations: The shared worktree contains unrelated user changes and untracked files; no unrelated files were modified, staged, reverted, or committed.
No live Alpaca/provider calls, credentials, network access, Azure storage, or MyPy run was used.
